sources.title: National Planning Policy Framework - Promoting healthy and safe communities
sources.role: National policy context for healthy communities, community facilities and open space.
sources.facts: Policies support healthy lives and robust assessments of open-space and recreation needs; policy text is not a site capacity or funding confirmation.
sources.guard: Health, community, open-space and education-estate sources do not by themselves prove site capacity, secured provision, adoption, funding, accessibility compliance or planning outcome.

sources.title: Healthy and safe communities
